name: signal-domain-chained-signal-blocks-propagate-the-value
source:
COMPONENT SigConst(out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k
END
COMPONENT SigGain(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k * in.sig
END
COMPONENT SigSum(in1, in2, out)
  out.sig = in1.sig + in2.sig
END
SigConst SRC(k=2)
SigGain  G1(k=3)
SigGain  G2(k=5)
connect(SRC.out, G1.in)
connect(G1.out, G2.in)
